Elias Phoenix, the piano prodigy many people remember from TV, recently shared deeply upsetting videos and memories from his childhood on X. In the posts, he described being pressured and scared at home while being pushed to perform at such a young age. Watching someone who was presented to the world as this happy, talented little kid speak about what was happening behind the scenes is heartbreaking. No child should have to carry that kind of fear, pressure, or pain just to make adults proud. Sending Elias love for speaking in his own words. #domesticabuseawareness #childstar #crimetiktok #abusesurvivor
